{
  "dataset_name": "first_order_theorem_proving",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "high_variance_feature_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Mean of features with high variance (V6, V8, V9, V12, V15, V17) that tend to have heavy right tails, capturing overall complexity signal",
      "value_range": [-1.5, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_statistics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth composite score summarizing high-variance dimensions useful for linear margin separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V6 + V8 + V9 + V12 + V15 + V17) / 6.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "low_variance_feature_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Mean of features with low variance (V33, V43) that have small std, capturing a different signal regime",
      "value_range": [-0.15, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_statistics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures low-variance signal dimensions that may linearly separate certain groups",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V33 + V43) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "l2_norm_first_block",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "L2 norm of first 10 features (V1-V10), representing overall magnitude in the first feature block",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "norm_magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth continuous magnitude measure useful as a linear projection component",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(V1**2 + V2**2 + V3**2 + V4**2 + V5**2 + V6**2 + V7**2 + V8**2 + V9**2 + V10**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "l2_norm_second_block",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "L2 norm of features V11-V20, representing overall magnitude in the second feature block",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "norm_magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures magnitude in a different feature subspace, complementing the first block norm for linear separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(V11**2 + V12**2 + V13**2 + V14**2 + V15**2 + V16**2 + V17**2 + V18**2 + V19**2 + V20**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "sparse_tail_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of features exceeding 2 standard deviations from zero (proxy for outlier/extreme feature activations), normalized by total features",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "sparsity_extremity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures how many features are in extreme ranges, providing a smooth sparsity-like score for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((np.abs(V1) > 2.0).astype(float) + (np.abs(V2) > 2.0).astype(float) + (np.abs(V3) > 2.0).astype(float) + (np.abs(V4) > 2.0).astype(float) + (np.abs(V5) > 2.0).astype(float) + (np.abs(V6) > 2.0).astype(float) + (np.abs(V7) > 2.0).astype(float) + (np.abs(V8) > 2.0).astype(float) + (np.abs(V9) > 2.0).astype(float) + (np.abs(V10) > 2.0).astype(float)) / 10.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "positive_feature_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of features V1-V25 that are positive, indicating directional bias in the feature space",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "directional_bias",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the proportion of positive-valued features as a smooth ratio useful for linear margin computation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((V1 > 0).astype(float) + (V2 > 0).astype(float) + (V3 > 0).astype(float) + (V4 > 0).astype(float) + (V5 > 0).astype(float) + (V6 > 0).astype(float) + (V7 > 0).astype(float) + (V8 > 0).astype(float) + (V9 > 0).astype(float) + (V10 > 0).astype(float) + (V11 > 0).astype(float) + (V12 > 0).astype(float) + (V13 > 0).astype(float) + (V14 > 0).astype(float) + (V15 > 0).astype(float) + (V16 > 0).astype(float) + (V17 > 0).astype(float) + (V18 > 0).astype(float) + (V19 > 0).astype(float) + (V20 > 0).astype(float) + (V21 > 0).astype(float) + (V22 > 0).astype(float) + (V23 > 0).astype(float) + (V24 > 0).astype(float) + (V25 > 0).astype(float)) / 25.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "log1p_heavy_tail_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log1p-transformed sum of absolute values of heavy-tailed features (V9, V12, V15, V17, V21, V22, V28, V29) to compress extreme values",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "compressed_magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses heavy-tailed distributions into a smooth score, improving linear separability by reducing outlier influence",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.abs(V9) + np.abs(V12) + np.abs(V15) + np.abs(V17) + np.abs(V21) + np.abs(V22) + np.abs(V28) + np.abs(V29))"
    },
    {
      "name": "feature_range_spread",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between max and min of a selected subset of features (V1,V3,V5,V7,V9,V11,V13,V15), measuring within-row spread",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "within_row_variability",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures within-row feature spread as a continuous measure, useful for linear SVM to distinguish compact vs dispersed feature profiles",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(V1, V3), V5), V7), V9), V11), V13), V15) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(V1, V3), V5), V7), V9), V11), V13), V15)"
    },
    {
      "name": "weighted_composite_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted linear combination of selected features emphasizing those with larger variance (V6, V9, V12, V20, V22, V28) with log1p compression",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an approximate linear projection that emphasizes high-information features, directly useful as a linear SVM input dimension",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.maximum(0.0, 0.3 * V6 + 0.2 * V9 + 0.15 * V12 + 0.15 * V20 + 0.1 * V22 + 0.1 * V28)) - np.log1p(np.maximum(0.0, -0.3 * V6 - 0.2 * V9 - 0.15 * V12 - 0.15 * V20 - 0.1 * V22 - 0.1 * V28))"
    },
    {
      "name": "negative_feature_magnitude",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of absolute values of features that are predominantly negative (V2, V7, V14, V32, V45, V51), capturing negative-direction signal strength",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "directional_magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the magnitude of features with negative bias, providing a complementary linear component to positive-direction features",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(V2) + np.abs(V7) + np.abs(V14) + np.abs(V32) + np.abs(V45) + np.abs(V51)"
    },
    {
      "name": "feature_block_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of mean absolute value of features V26-V51 to mean absolute value of features V1-V25, measuring relative signal strength between blocks",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "block_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures relative signal distribution between feature blocks as a smooth ratio, useful for linear SVM to detect block-level patterns",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.abs(V26) + np.abs(V27) + np.abs(V28) + np.abs(V29) + np.abs(V30) + np.abs(V31) + np.abs(V32) + np.abs(V33) + np.abs(V34) + np.abs(V35) + np.abs(V36) + np.abs(V37) + np.abs(V38) + np.abs(V39) + np.abs(V40) + np.abs(V41) + np.abs(V42) + np.abs(V43) + np.abs(V44) + np.abs(V45) + np.abs(V46) + np.abs(V47) + np.abs(V48) + np.abs(V49) + np.abs(V50) + np.abs(V51)) / (np.abs(V1) + np.abs(V2) + np.abs(V3) + np.abs(V4) + np.abs(V5) + np.abs(V6) + np.abs(V7) + np.abs(V8) + np.abs(V9) + np.abs(V10) + np.abs(V11) + np.abs(V12) + np.abs(V13) + np.abs(V14) + np.abs(V15) + np.abs(V16) + np.abs(V17) + np.abs(V18) + np.abs(V19) + np.abs(V20) + np.abs(V21) + np.abs(V22) + np.abs(V23) + np.abs(V24) + np.abs(V25) + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_complexity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall feature complexity based on the combination of high-magnitude features, spread, and tail behavior. Higher scores indicate more complex feature profiles with many extreme values and high inter-feature variability, suggesting harder theorem proving instances.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_complexity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic complexity signal that captures non-linear interactions between feature extremity, spread, and magnitude in a single smooth score for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
